text: The X1 (犀旺) brand site says the sports nutrition drink was jointly launched by China Sports Industry Group and ORG (奥瑞金); ORG's 2025 annual report calls 犀旺 its own brand (自有品牌).
short: X1 was launched jointly by ORG and China Sports Industry Group; ORG calls it its own brand

source.name: 犀旺运动营养饮料 (xiwangworld.com): 关于犀旺 ABOUT XIWANG
source.quote: 犀旺运动营养饮料，是由中体产业集团与奥瑞金联合推出的，专为中国规律运动人群研发的新一代运动营养饮料。
